title: What does the motivic identity tell us about the topology or cohomology of these moduli spaces

problemStatement.formal: Given [Omega^2_beta(Fl_{n+1})] = [GL_n] * [A^a] in K_0(Var_k), derive concrete consequences for the topology and cohomology of Omega^2_beta(Fl_{n+1}) via motivic-measure realization functors mu : K_0(Var) -> R.
problemStatement.plain: The parent (BEMSV 2025) identity equates the motivic class of a moduli space of based rational maps to flag varieties with that of GL_n times affine space. What does this say about Betti numbers, Euler characteristics, Hodge numbers, and point counts?
whyMatters: Motivic identities are weaker than isomorphism or homotopy equivalence; the only direct topological content is what passes through realization functors.

Each realization mu (Euler characteristic, point counts over F_q, Hodge-Deligne polynomial, Poincare polynomial when motive is pure Tate) carries the identity to a concrete numerical or polynomial equality.
The current Lean formalization treats K_0(Var) as an abstract structure with no realization homomorphism, so the topological consequences are entirely unexposed in the gallery.

proven: Parent identity in K_0(Var) is axiomatized; downstream Lean theorems Fl_n_class, GL_n_class, projective_class_formula derived as ring identities.
Sibling OQ-01: grassmannianClass_duality proved via Polynomial Z universality (no axioms beyond parent).
Sibling OQ-02: partial-flag extension formalized in 635 lines, 3 axioms, 0 sorries.
open: S2-A: Euler characteristic of Omega^2_beta(Fl_{n+1}) vanishes (cheap).
S2-B: Point count over F_q equals q^a * prod(q^i - 1) * q^{n(n-1)/2} (broader).
S2-C: L^{n(n-1)/2}-divisibility of [Omega^2_beta(Fl_{n+1})] in K_0(Var) (narrowest, axiom-free).
knownResults.goal: Pull the BEMSV motivic identity through standard realization functors to extract concrete topological/cohomological invariants of the moduli space.

insights: Identity-of-realization framework: each topological invariant is a ring hom mu : K_0(Var) -> R with mu(L) = c; motivic identity propagates verbatim through each.
Euler characteristic of GL_n is 0 for n >= 1, so chi(Omega^2_beta(Fl_{n+1})) = 0 falls out trivially from the motivic identity.
L^{n(n-1)/2} divides [GL_n] structurally; this descends to [Omega^2_beta(Fl_{n+1})] without any realization, making S2-C the smallest doc-to-Lean target.
Mathlib v4.26.0 has no K_0(Var), no EulerCharacteristic of a variety, no point-count infrastructure. Realization homomorphisms must be structure-encoded.
Sibling OQ-01 (axiom elimination) and OQ-02 (partial-flag extension) are orthogonal to OQ-03 (downstream realizations); no duplication risk.
MotivicMeasure should be a structure (user-supplied instance), not an axiom. Adding it does not raise the axiomCount of MotivicFlagMaps.lean.
